Excellent! After Bg7+ Kg8 Rxe5, Black has no checks or captures—White is simply up a pawn with the bishop on e7 also under attack. This is the winning line.

**Best move:** Bg7+

**Main line:** Bg7+ Kg8 Rxe5 Bxe5 (or any move) and White is up material.

**Motif:** pin (the e5 pawn is pinned to the king—it cannot be defended because the king blocks)

**Explanation (coaching note):**
When a piece is pinned to the king, it becomes a target you can attack multiple times with impunity. After Bg7+ forces the king to g8, the e5 pawn is now pinned and attacked twice—by your bishop and rook—but defended zero times. Winning it cleanly nets you a pawn. Look for pins to the king to find "free" captures.
